aya.1: The tea is ready. Sit down and play a few rounds with me?
aya.2: The table feels peaceful today—perfect for thinking things through.
aya.3: Don't rush your discard. I want to see how you build your hand.
aya.4: If you're tired, have some tea first. The table isn't going anywhere.
aya.5: A good hand takes patience, just like tea needs time to steep.
aya.6: I won't go easy on you just because it's you.
aya.7: Your face gives away your whole hand... I'm only teasing.
aya.8: Want to guess which tile I'm hoping to draw?
aya.9: Winning doesn't matter? Say that again after you beat me.
aya.10: One more round. I haven't seen enough of your style yet.

mio.1: ...You're here? Sit. A quiet game sounds good.
mio.2: You don't need to talk. The tiles tell me what you're thinking.
mio.3: Don't discard that one... Never mind. Forget I said anything.
mio.4: You're hesitating too long. The table won't wait.
mio.5: My luck is average today. Good. I'll win with judgment.
mio.6: Don't stare at me. Watch your own tiles.
mio.7: Focus if you want to win. I won't remind you twice.
mio.9: Decide what to discard before you draw. It's faster.

sora.1: Oh, you're here. Ready to make this a lively match?
sora.2: Just so we're clear, don't blame my amazing luck when you lose.
sora.3: This tile is telling me to keep it—probably.
sora.4: Were you just trying to read my expression?
sora.5: Come on, hurry up! Good tiles hate waiting.
sora.6: If I win by self-draw, you're buying me something nice to drink.
sora.7: Relax. I only happen to be smiling suspiciously.
sora.8: Let's make this round exciting. Dare to follow my lead?
sora.9: Nothing at this table is luck—only my brilliant predictions.
sora.10: Click again? Sure. Let's see what else I have to say.

help.title: Rules & Scoring
help.ruleGoal: Complete five melds and one pair. A concealed hand normally has 16 tiles and 17 after drawing.
help.ruleTurn: Turns proceed counterclockwise. Draw one tile and discard one tile; if no action is taken within 30 seconds, the computer acts for that player.
help.ruleFlowers: A flower is exposed as soon as it is drawn, then a replacement tile is drawn from the wall.
help.ruleCalls: Chow may only claim the previous player's discard; Pong, Kong and a winning discard may be claimed when available. An exposed Pong may be upgraded to Kong after drawing the fourth tile.
help.ruleReady: Declaring ready locks the hand. Future non-winning draws are discarded automatically.
help.scoringFormula: Payment per opponent = 500 base points + total tai × 200 points.
help.scoringDiscard: Win by discard: only the discarder pays one payment; it is not tripled.
help.scoringSelfDraw: Self-draw: each of the other three players pays the payment.
help.scoringCoins: After settlement, every {points} table points converts to 1 coin. Funds never fall below zero.
